---
name: 💡 Feature Request
about: Propose a new feature, idea, or capability for Flashcard Master
title: '[Feature]: '
labels: ['enhancement']
assignees: ''
---

### Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of what problem you are facing or what limitation you've encountered.
*Example: "I am always frustrated when trying to export cards to RemNote because only Anki and CSV are currently supported."*

### Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how you envision this feature working.

### Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### Architectural Impact & Invariants
- Which layer would this touch? (Core domain models, Adapters / Ingestion / Exporters, Web UI, CLI)
- Does this maintain local-first privacy (zero external telemetry)?
- Does this respect our 4 official supported LLM providers?

### Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.
